# Appendix: Documentation

```{=typst}
// appendix: smaller text than the report sections, subsections in frames
#set text(size: 8.5pt)
#show table: set text(size: 7.5pt)
#let pcgr-doc-box(body) = block(
  width: 100%, breakable: true, inset: (x: 10pt, top: 8pt, bottom: 9pt),

  above: 0.9em, below: 0.9em, body)
```

This report is intended for interpretation of multi-omics data from a single human tumor sample. The documentation is also available in the HTML report, and at the [PCGR documentation website](https://sigven.github.io/pcgr).

```{r documentation_pdf_notes}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

## documentation notes as in the HTML report (Documentation - Report
## content), each in a frame
doc_box <- function(title, ...) {
  cat("```{=typst}\n#pcgr-doc-box[\n```\n\n",
      "### ", title, "\n\n",
      paste(vapply(list(...), pcgrr:::doc_note_markdown, character(1)),
            collapse = "\n\n"),
      "\n\n```{=typst}\n]\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}
doc_box("Key findings summary", pcgrr::key_findings_doc_note())
doc_box("Sample and subject properties", paste0(
  "- **Age** refers to the age of the subject (in whole years) at ",
  "diagnosis, as provided with the `--age` option\n",
  "- **Sex** of the subject is provided with the `--sex` option, and is ",
  "used for the annotation of copy number losses on the sex chromosomes\n",
  "- **Tumor purity** and **tumor ploidy** are shown with their source: ",
  "*provided* - values estimated with other tools (e.g. ASCAT) and provided ",
  "with `--tumor_purity` / `--tumor_ploidy`; *estimated* - tumor ploidy ",
  "estimated by PCGR from the copy number segments (genome-wide weighted ",
  "median) when not provided. Tumor purity is never estimated by PCGR"))
doc_box("Variant oncogenicity classification",
        pcgrr::oncogenicity_doc_note(),
        "**A note on variant loss-of-function annotation**",
        pcgrr::lof_doc_note())
doc_box("Variant actionability classification", pcgrr::actionability_doc_note())
doc_box("Mutational signature analysis", pcgrr::mutational_signatures_doc_note())
doc_box("Tumor mutational burden (TMB) analysis", pcgrr::tmb_doc_note())
doc_box("MSI classification", pcgrr::msi_doc_note())
doc_box("RNA fusion analysis", pcgrr::fusion_doc_note())
doc_box("Gene expression analysis", pcgrr::expression_doc_note())
doc_box("Two-hit detection", pcgrr::twohit_doc_note())
```
